instructions: CmsCore imports the official technical writing, API reference, navigation, and page utility blocs.
The blocs expose attributes, slots, CSS custom properties, and parts for site-level presentation.
checks: No source, secret, connector, or dashboard is installed.
Re-running the installation refreshes the owned bloc sources with force.
The imported sources remain editable in the site bloc folder.
resources: Documentation layout, navigation, API, code, and content primitives
review: Use these blocs as the shared documentation vocabulary across sites.
Override visual treatment through the site theme before creating specialized copies.
sync: Install navigation and page utility blocs
syncNote: This integration installs only bloc artifacts and can be re-run to refresh them.
